sloka: पितामह वरो अस्माकम् इष्क्वाकूणाम् महात्मनाम् ।त्रिशन्कुर् विमलो भाति राज ऋषिः सपुरोहितः ॥६-४-५०॥।।
transliteration: pitāmaha varo asmākam iṣkvākūṇām mahātmanām ।triśankur vimalo bhāti rāja ṛṣiḥ sapurohitaḥ ॥6-4-50॥।।

translations.english: Among the great kings of the Ikshvaku dynasty, the grandfather Trisanku who is a royal sage shines clearly along with Vasishta the foremost priest.
